lines.quote: Primary developer of the embedded C/C++ signal processing modules for vehicle-mounted structural health monitoring systems. Built the vibration analysis firmware running on ARM Cortex-M7 processors, processing distributed accelerometer data at 50 kHz for real-time fatigue crack detection.

Designed and deployed a Python data pipeline for post-exercise analysis: automated ingestion of field recorder files (typically 40–80 GB per session), feature extraction, trend analysis, and anomaly flagging.

requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: Candidate explicitly states his background is in vibration analysis rather than radar or RF systems; no RF measurement work is described.

lines.quote: I have also contributed to some publications in the structural monitoring area over the years.
As the holder of a Finnish permanent residence permit (type P, EU work authorisation), served as Meridian's technical contributor to the Helsinki signal processing work package.
All technical work at Meridian is conducted in English: source code, specifications, test reports, and weekly coordination calls with partner organisations in Germany and the UK.
Willing to relocate to Oulu for the right role — no dependants or other constraints.
I am open to relocating from Helsinki to Oulu without difficulty.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
